name: Red Plates
source:
Kiko and Yuna have recently moved to the city from the countryside. Kiko hopes to train a larger audience as she is a physical fitness instructor. Yuna is a suspense writer who seeks the thrill of the city to flesh out new stories after she encounters massive writers block. While unpacking Yuna notices a strange red plate and inquires as to what it is.. even Kiko doesn't know. All she knows is that it comes as a family heirloom passed down from her mom....

They will soon find out much, much more.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=26700]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
